intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in New York City for 2026, and here is what he found: 39 family events after the borough cards move to their own pages. Two new free Manhattan picks join the list, the 30th Annual Central Park Holiday Lighting at the Dana Discovery Center (December 3) and Holiday on the Hudson at West Harlem Piers (December 5), alongside the Rockefeller Center tree lighting (December 2), the Radio City Christmas Spectacular and the Bank of America Winter Village at Bryant Park. We check every date on the host's own website, and each card links straight there.

What Rally found in New York

  • 39 Christmas events for kids in New York City after the borough moves
  • 2 new free events: the Central Park Holiday Lighting at the Dana Discovery Center and Holiday on the Hudson at West Harlem Piers
  • Tree lightings: Rockefeller Center (December 2) and Central Park (December 3)
  • Trains: the New York Transit Museum Holiday Train Show at Grand Central and Holiday Nostalgia Rides
  • Meet Santa: Macy's Santaland, Here Comes Santa at Hudson Yards and Santa's Corner at Bryant Park

Heading out to the boroughs? See our guides to Christmas events for kids in Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx and Staten Island.
